## About This Template {#setup-guide}

This repository is a ready-to-use **GitHub Template** designed to build and host a Quarto website on GitHub Pages. It is pre-configured to automatically render and package documents in multiple formats (PDF, EPUB, ODT, GFM) and display download links at the top of each page's sidebar.

### Features
- **Automated GitHub Actions:** Every push compiles and publishes the latest website to GitHub Pages.
- **Multi-Format Sidebar Links:** Custom scripts automatically move format download links to the sidebar for a cleaner layout.
- **Preconfigured Typst styling:** Ready-to-go Lua filters and Typst template for high-quality PDF renders.
- **Responsive Theme switching:** Supports Materia (light) and Darkly (dark) themes out of the box.
